project_overview.description: Responsive Web adaptation of the Expo Go 'cash' personal finance mobile app. Prioritizes fidelity to original mobile workflows, financial calculations (Saldo Livre Real, Posso Comprar Isso?, Metas, Contas Fixas vs Gastos Avulsos, Cartões), while expanding into a high-density, double-column Bento Web Dashboard for desktop and mobile web.
project_overview.design_persona: E1 Creative Designer - High Precision Financial Command Center
project_overview.theme_strategy: Dual Mode (Dark & Light) with system default sync and explicit header toggle. Dark Mode primary anchor: Slate Dark Obsidian. Light Mode primary anchor: Soft Sand Clean Grey.

hierarchy_rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none

anti_patterns: Never use Inter or generic sans for Main and Sub-headings
Never exceed text-6xl for hero headers on desktop viewports
Always set tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for headlines over 32px

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & PERFORMANCE PRO FUSION (Trust, Emerald Teal, Precision Financial Focus)

contrast_rules.interactive_hover_rule: Always explicitly define hover:text-* alongside hover:bg-* to guarantee legible contrast
contrast_rules.tinted_grey_rule: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Neutral greys are subtly tinted with slate blue hue

desktop_navigation.type: Left Collapsible Vertical Sidebar + Top Glass Sticky Bar

mobile_navigation.type: Sticky Top Header + Bottom Fixed Navigation Dock

grid_protocol.desktop_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto

surface_strategies.header_nav: Crystal Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50 z-40 sticky top-0
surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background with subtle 1px border (border-border/60), rounded-xl, transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/40
surface_strategies.hero_saldo_livre_card: Prominent Emerald Gradient/Solid Surface (bg-teal-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/80) with rounded-2xl, subtle inner border (border-emerald-400/30), high-contrast text, glowing action button
surface_strategies.posso_comprar_modal: Glass backdrop scrim overlay (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md) with crisp floating card modal, custom currency masked input, and clear simulation breakdown state

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Desktop: 2-column Bento Grid featuring Saldo Livre Real banner, Posso Comprar simulation widget, Stat counters (Entrou, Gasto, Previsto), and Contas Pagas badge. Mobile: Single vertical stack.
key_elements: Month Navigation Dropdown Selector with quick prev/next month chevrons
Saldo Disponível vs Metas total top metrics
Stat cards with interactive drill-down filters
Saldo Livre Real hero banner
Interactive 'Posso comprar isso?' simulation modal & floating quick trigger
Monthly pace alert box

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Interactive timeline list with monthly forecast card and minimum predicted balance alert banner.
key_elements: Total dos próximos lançamentos sum card
Minimum predicted balance warning badge
Chronological transaction items with day pill badges, recurrence type, and value indicator

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Tabbed view (Fixas vs Gastos Avulsos) with data table / item cards, category icons, payment checkbox toggles, and direct add buttons.
key_elements: Header total for current active tab
Cartões quick summary preview button
Tabs switcher (Fixas / Gastos)
Fixed account row with toggleable payment checkbox and status highlight
Category color badge & icon
Dashed border button to add new entry

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Stacked 3D virtual credit cards list on desktop/mobile with interactive card flip/details, invoice closing dates, limits, and installments timeline.
key_elements: Total credit card commitment summary card
Visual credit cards stack with brand badges, masked number, card nickname, and monthly total
Add credit card FAB / button
Card invoice drill-down with subscriptions and installments list

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Grid of goal cards with progress rings, saved amount, monthly contribution allocation, and add deposit drawer.
key_elements: Total guardado em metas metric
Goal card with target amount, current balance, progress bar %
Monthly deposit allocation badge (aporteMensal)
Add goal modal with category icon selector

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Recharts donut chart for category distribution and bar chart for month-over-month comparison.
key_elements: Category comparison charts
Top spending categories rank list
Month-over-month percentage change badges

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Slide-over right drawer on desktop / Bottom sheet modal on mobile web.
key_elements: Step 1: Formatted Real currency input (R$ 0,00 mask)
Step 2: Category grid selector with color pills
Step 3: Payment method (Débito, Crédito, PIX, Dinheiro)
Step 4: Recurrence / Installments configuration (single, monthly, installments count)
Step 5: Date picker and notes input

component_mapping_expo_to_web.responsiveness: Settings modal/page for theme toggles, notification reminders, and interactive Onboarding tour wizard.
key_elements: Light/Dark theme toggle switch
Notification and reminder preference toggles
Reset onboarding button for testing user flows
Multi-step Onboarding slides introducing 'Saldo Livre Real'

shadcn_primitives: Use Dialog / Sheet for transaction drawers and 'Posso comprar isso?' calculator
Use Tabs for Contas (Fixas vs Gastos Avulsos) switching
Use Calendar / Popover for custom date picking
Use Select for month navigation and category selection
Use Sonner for toast notifications on item deletion, payment status changes, and settings updates
Use Custom Tailwind HTML containers for asymmetric dashboard Bento grids rather than standard nested cards

charts_system.donut_chart: Category spending distribution with custom tooltip and dark/light mode stroke colors
charts_system.bar_chart: Monthly income vs expense trend comparison

framer_motion_rules: Use AnimatePresence for tab switching between Fixas and Gastos Avulsos
Use subtle hover scaling (scale: 1.02) and lift (-translate-y-0.5) for dashboard cards
Slide-in transitions for slide-over drawer modals
Smooth height expansion for card invoice breakdown items
Always include prefers-reduced-motion check to disable motion for users with motion sensitivity

testing_and_accessibility.test_id_convention: All key buttons, inputs, values, cards, and navigation links MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case

media_and_assets.icons: Lucide React / Phosphor Icons (@heroicons/react or lucide-react)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure complete feature fidelity to the original Expo app (Saldo Livre Real formula, Posso Comprar calculator, payment status toggling, Month Context, Theme Context).
Build modular React components using `.js` file extensions inside `src/components/` and `src/pages/`.
Structure desktop view as a modern SaaS financial dashboard with left sidebar, top header, and Bento grid, while providing a seamless mobile web view with sticky top header and bottom nav dock.
Do NOT alter or touch any existing Expo mobile files under /app/app-financeiro-full/. Keep all new web code isolated in /app/frontend/.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for automated testing.
